package.author: mircearoata
package.description: Handles Satisfactory mods and mod loader.

en-US.author: mircearoata
en-US.description: Handles Satisfactory mods and mod loader.
en-US.longDescription: Handles all the steps of installing mods, including download of SML and Bootstrapper.
en-US.name: Satisfactory Mod Manager
en-US.releaseNotes:
Installation
─────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┬─────────────
Windows      │Linux                                                                      │MacOS
─────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────
Download     │Download (AppImage)                                                        │Download
─────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────
             │Download (standalone)                                                      │
             │requires libwebkit2gtk-4.1                                                 │
             │and gst-plugins-good                                                       │
─────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┴─────────────
If you already have Satisfactory Mod Manager installed, you don't need to download it again, it will auto-update.

Code Signing Policy
Windows binaries are signed using free code signing provided by SignPath.io, certificate by SignPath Foundation

Changelog
- Add network use disclosure
- Add AI disclosure icon (#366)
- Add controller combatibility icon (#365)
- Add faugus launcher support
- Add support for the Epic Launcher preview
- Add crash popup
- Fix random crashes when downloading multiple mods at once
- Fix Epic installs not being found for fresh installations of the old Epic Launcher
- Fix launching Epic installs
- Fix crashes due to new WebView version on Windows
- Fix legendary installs not being found due to changes in legendary config
- Fix AppImage crashing on pages containing emojis
- Fix video playback in AppImage
- Fix launching host apps from AppImage (such as the browser)
- Fix import profile warning about profile's game version
- Fix tag filter list not scrolling
- Handle ~/.steam being moved outside $HOME
